audit: MBC Creator Phase 4 Full-Stack Implementation Audit

findings.title: Missing expectedVersion Concurrency Contract in Step 4.6 Pricing Strategy
findings.description: POST /api/creator/phase4/pricing/generate, POST /api/creator/phase4/pricing/refresh, and PATCH /api/creator/phase4/pricing/{offerKey} do not accept an expectedVersion query parameter, do not populate HttpContext.Items["CreatorIdeaVersion"], and do not publish the canonical X-Creator-Idea-Version response header. The frontend API client (src/lib/api-creator-pricing.ts) does not participate in optimistic concurrency caching.
findings.impact: Concurrent multi-tab edits or simultaneous generation requests risk silent overwrites without optimistic locking conflict detection (HTTP 409).
findings.recommendedFix: Add [FromQuery] long? expectedVersion = null to pricing endpoints, populate HttpContext.Items["CreatorIdeaVersion"], emit Response.Headers["X-Creator-Idea-Version"], and update api-creator-pricing.ts to use resolveExpectedVersion(), rememberIdeaVersion(), and setIdeaVersion().
findings.fixSummary: Added [FromQuery] long? expectedVersion = null to all Pricing controller actions (GetPricing, GeneratePricing, RefreshPricing, UpdatePricingOffer) with optimistic locking conflict checks. Populated HttpContext.Items['CreatorIdeaVersion'] and X-Creator-Idea-Version response header. Set IdeaVersion on PricingStrategyResponse from journey.IdeaVersion in PricingStrategyService. Updated src/types/creator/pricing.ts and src/lib/api-creator-pricing.ts to cache, track, and send expectedVersion across all pricing API requests.

findings.title: Missing expectedVersion Concurrency Contract in Step 4.5 Aids & Grants
findings.description: POST /api/creator/phase4/support/generate, POST /api/creator/phase4/support/refresh, and PATCH /api/creator/phase4/support/{matchKey} do not validate expectedVersion or emit X-Creator-Idea-Version response headers, leading to inconsistent concurrency protection relative to Steps 4.1–4.4.
findings.impact: Potential for stale state overrides when saving eligibility facts or support options during concurrent tab sessions.
findings.recommendedFix: Add expectedVersion query parameter and header publishing to Step 4.5 endpoints and API client.
findings.fixSummary: Added [FromQuery] long? expectedVersion = null to GetSupportPlan, GenerateSupportPlan, RefreshSupportPlan, UpdateFounderSupportState, and AnswerEligibilityFact with optimistic concurrency validation. Attached HttpContext.Items['CreatorIdeaVersion'] and Response.Headers['X-Creator-Idea-Version']. Updated SupportPlanService to return IdeaVersion from journey.IdeaVersion. Updated src/types/creator/support.ts and src/lib/api-creator-support.ts to handle version resolution and caching.

findings.title: Inconsistent TraceIdentifier in Step 4.5 and 4.6 Controller Error Responses
findings.description: Catch blocks in Step 4.5 and Step 4.6 endpoints invoke ApiResponse.Error(ex.Message) without passing HttpContext.TraceIdentifier, whereas Steps 4.1–4.4 consistently pass the active trace identifier.
findings.impact: Production client error logs cannot be correlated with backend APM server trace identifiers.
findings.recommendedFix: Pass HttpContext.TraceIdentifier as second argument to all ApiResponse.Error(...) calls in controller catch handlers.
findings.fixSummary: Updated all catch blocks and error paths across Step 4.5 Support Plan and Step 4.6 Pricing Strategy controller endpoints in CreatorPhase4ConstructionController.cs to pass HttpContext.TraceIdentifier in ApiResponse.Error(ex.Message, HttpContext.TraceIdentifier).

findings.title: Unwrapped Asynchronous State Update Warning in Support Plan Unit Test
findings.description: Vitest test run emits non-fatal console warning 'An update to SupportPlanView inside a test was not wrapped in act(...)' during the inline location fact submission test case.
findings.impact: Zero production runtime impact; test harness console noise.
findings.recommendedFix: Wrap the async fact dispatch in act(async () => { ... }) in phase4-support-plan.test.tsx.
findings.fixSummary: Imported act from @testing-library/react and wrapped the async onAnswerFact dispatch in act(async () => { ... }) inside src/__tests__/creator/phase4-support-plan.test.tsx.

findings.title: Implicit Generic Return Type on Support API Helper
findings.description: src/lib/api-creator-support.ts defines unwrap helper without explicit generic constraint annotations.
findings.recommendedFix: Add explicit <T> generic constraint and return type annotation.
findings.fixSummary: Added explicit generic signature async function unwrap<T>(promise: Promise<{ data?: T; success?: boolean; error?: string }>): Promise<T> in src/lib/api-creator-support.ts.
